resolved_intents.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is displayed
Get tell your experience text value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should retrieve the current text from the feedback text field using get_entered_text() and verify that the text length does not exceed the expected maximum character limit (typically 1000 characters based on the character counter). The method should assert that len(text) <= expected_max_length and return True if truncation is working correctly, False otherwise. It should also verify that the character count display shows the correct truncated length.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback')
Call existing method self.get_entered_text() to retrieve the current text value from the feedback text field
Calculate the actual character count by computing len() of the retrieved text string
Assert that the calculated length is less than or equal to expected_max_length parameter using assert len(text) <= expected_max_length
Wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' element to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback_char_count', timeout=10)
Retrieve the character count display text using self.driver.get_attribute('edit_feedback_char_count', 'Name', timeout=10)
Parse the character count display text to extract the current count value (format expected: 'X/Y' where X is current count)
Assert that the displayed current count matches the actual text length calculated earlier
Assert that the displayed current count does not exceed expected_max_length
Return True if all assertions pass successfully
